uml.title: UML Preparation
uml.tooltip: Generate, refine, and edit Use Case, Class, Sequence, and Activity diagrams rendered directly with PlantUML.
uml.description: Design and generate system architecture models with interactive PlantUML rendering and entity editing.
uml.suggestionDescription: Review and accept the generated diagram model.

descriptions.usecase: Define the system boundary, primary/secondary actors, and actions with <<include>> and <<extend>> relations.
descriptions.sequence: Define multi-tier architectural participants, message flows, activations, and alternative paths.
descriptions.activity: Map core business workflows with decision diamonds (if/else), actions, and terminal endpoints.
descriptions.class: Define domain entities with attributes, typed methods, and standard UML relationships.

uml.diagramSyncDescription: Each diagram is generated and refined independently with synced PlantUML rendering.
